# Odette Pullen

## Overview

- **Age:** Sixteen in Volume 1; nineteen or twenty in Volume 2.  <sub>[v1 c13 P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c15 P24](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0024), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010)</sub>
- **Gender:** Female  <sub>[v1 c13 P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011)</sub>
- **Status:** Alive  <sub>[v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021)</sub>
- **Origin:** Brierley  <sub>[v1 c13 P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v1 c15 P8](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0008)</sub>
- **Role:** Schoolteacher  <sub>[v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## Appearance

Odette has lovely skin, curly brown hair, and styles her hair very fashionably. She is a sensible and practical girl, slightly plump, but does not care for an excess of romance or sentimentality in her appearance or stories. She looks very respectable and plain-spoken in her demeanor.

_Sources: [v1 c13 P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c17 P19](../source/v01-c17.md#nw-v01-c17-p0019), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## Personality

Odette is a sensible, practical, and matter-of-fact girl who dislikes unnecessary sentimentality or romance. She is honest and straightforward, often expressing her opinions directly and lacking interest in flowery or creative imaginings. Despite her lack of imagination, she is good-natured, supportive of her friends, and very reliable. She approaches work and studies diligently, aiming to fulfill her duties and satisfy authorities rather than seeking grand ideals or fame.

_Sources: [v1 c13 P13](../source/v01-c13.md#nw-v01-c13-p0013), [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c26 P21](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0021), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)_

## Goals

- To qualify for and work as a schoolteacher to earn her own income  <sub>[v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>
- To fulfill her educational duties without being dependent on a husband  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>

## History

Odette grew up in Brierley, studying at the local school alongside her peers. In her late teens, she prepared for the entrance examination for Regent's Academy under the guidance of Mr. Pidgeon and later Miss Agnes Thorne. She joined the student Story Club, writing sensible and realistic stories, and actively participated in school concerts and events. After successfully passing the Entrance examinations, she attended Regent's Academy in Portmaris with Nell Harcourt, Opal Pettigrew, and others. Upon completing her Second Class work, she secured a position as a schoolteacher in Stonebridge, intending to dedicate her life to pedagogy and financial independence.

_Sources: [v1 c15 P11](../source/v01-c15.md#nw-v01-c15-p0011), [v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010), [v1 c26 P20](../source/v01-c26.md#nw-v01-c26-p0020), [v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021), [v1 c36 P24](../source/v01-c36.md#nw-v01-c36-p0024)_

## Quotes

> If my pupils won’t do as I tell them I shall punish them.  <sub>[v1 c24 P2](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0002)</sub>

> I’ll give my pupils a whipping whenever they misbehave. That is the most direct and simple method to persuade them.  <sub>[v1 c24 P10](../source/v01-c24.md#nw-v01-c24-p0010)</sub>

> Odette states she means to dedicate her entire existence to pedagogy and refuse marriage forever and ever, since teaching yields an earned income, whereas a spouse provides no compensation and complains should you request a portion of the revenue from butter and eggs.  <sub>[v1 c30 P21](../source/v01-c30.md#nw-v01-c30-p0021)</sub>
